description.en: Race against the ticking clock! Power-level through monster zones, buy gear in villages, and storm the Demon Castle before time runs out. Spend Crystals at Camp for permanent Roguelike upgrades and conquer higher World Loops.
description.zh-TW: 與倒數時鐘賽跑！在怪物荒野中極速練等、進村秒買裝備、衝進魔王城討伐魔王！每局結算魔晶永久強化營地天賦，挑戰更高輪迴的世界！

instructions.en: Move with WASD / Arrow Keys (or drag on touch). Press Space to Dash. Bump into monsters for instant high-speed combat, visit villages to pause the clock, heal, and upgrade gear, and slay the Demon Lord before time expires!
instructions.zh-TW: 使用 WASD 或方向鍵移動（手機可拖曳搖桿），空白鍵衝刺。撞擊怪物自動高速戰鬥，進村莊暫停計時、回滿血並強化裝備，在時間歸零前衝進魔王城擊敗魔王！

controls.en:
- WASD or Arrow Keys (or drag on touch) to move
- Space or Shift to Dash
- 1 / 2 inside a Village to buy Weapon or Armor
- Space or Esc to leave Village
